title: Senior Salesforce Developer
description: About the Role You will own the technical design and build of complex Salesforce features, from requirement to production. You will write clean, secure and well-tested code, lead by example on standards, and guide junior developers. You will work in agile teams alongside architects, business analysts, QA and client product owners, often presenting solutions directly to client stakeholders. Key responsibilities Translate business requirements into technical designs, choosing the right mix of declarative tools, Apex and LWC. Build and maintain Apex classes, triggers (using a trigger framework), batch, queueable and scheduled jobs, and Lightning Web Components. Design and build integrations with core banking, credit bureau, payment and document systems using REST/SOAP APIs, Platform Events and Named Credentials. Build and extend Experience Cloud portals for customers, brokers and partners, including sharing, guest user security and performance. Write bulk-safe, governor-limit-aware code with meaningful unit tests (minimum 85% coverage with real assertions). Follow and enforce CK coding standards, exception handling, Flow, LWC and security standards through peer code reviews. Own deployments through source control and CI/CD pipelines across sandboxes and production. Troubleshoot production issues, perform root cause analysis and deliver permanent fixes. Mentor junior and mid-level developers and contribute to estimates, sprint planning and technical documentation. Engage directly with client teams in workshops, demos and stand-ups. Must-have skills and experience 3+ years of hands-on Salesforce development on Salesforce Platform, Sales Cloud, Service Cloud or Financial Services Cloud. Strong Apex: triggers, asynchronous Apex, design patterns, exception handling and test classes. Strong SOQL and SOSL, including query optimisation, selectivity and large data volume considerations. Lightning Web Components and JavaScript (ES6+), with working knowledge of Aura. Hands-on Experience Cloud (Communities) development: site setup, LWC on Experience Builder, sharing sets, guest user access. Salesforce security model: profiles, permission sets, OWD, sharing rules, Apex managed sharing, CRUD/FLS and with/without sharing. Record-triggered and screen Flows, and judgement on when to use Flow versus Apex. API integrations (REST, SOAP, Platform Events, Change Data Capture) and authentication (OAuth, Named Credentials). Salesforce DX, Git and at least one CI/CD tool such as Copado, Gearset or GitHub Actions. Good Communication Skills. What we offer Work on live, business-critical Salesforce platforms for regulated banks and lenders. Direct client exposure and a clear path to Technical Lead and Architect roles.
